title: Recovering edge assignments from labelings
statement: Let $q,k,n\in\mathbb{N}$. For any perfect matching in the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices per part, assign a label in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ to each matching edge and give both endpoints that edge's label. Converting this labeling back to an edge assignment recovers the original matching and every edge label.
hypotheses_covered: natural numbers q, k, and n
a perfect matching in the complete q-partite graph
